blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “Whoever spends a pair (for example, two horses, two garments, two dirhams, two slaves and the like) in the path of Allah Ta'ala, the keepers of Jannah will call him. The keeper of every gate (of Jannah) will call out, “O so-and-so, enter through this gate.”” On hearing this, Hazrat Abu Bakr (RA) said, “O Rasulullah! In that case he will have no fear at all!” Rasulullah ﷺ said, “I have hope in Allah Ta'ala that you will be among those who are called from every gate.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ ثَوْبَانَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: أَفْضَلُ دِينَارٍ دِينَارٌ يُنْفِقُهُ الرَّجُلُ عَلي عِيَالِهِ، وَدِينَارٌ يُنْفِقُهُ عَلي فَرَسِهِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللهِ، وَدِينَارٌ يُنْفِقُهُ الرَّجُلُ عَلي أَصْحَابِهِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللهِ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Thawban (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “Of the gold dinars a person spends, the dinar he spends on his household, the dinar he spends on his horse in the path of Allah Ta'ala, and the dinar a person spends on his companions in the path of Allah are the best dinars.” (Dinar is the name given to a gold coin.)

blocks.arabic_text: وَيُرْوَي عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: مَا رَأَيْتُ أَحَدًا أَكْثَرَ مَشُورَةً لِأَصْحَابِهِ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللهِ ﷺ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي، باب ما جاء في المشورة، رقم:١٧١٤
blocks.tamil_translation: “I have not seen anyone consult his companions as much as Rasulullah ﷺ consulted his companions (he used to consult a great deal),” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA)
